evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI acknowledged remaining predictive uncertainty. It did not attribute that uncertainty to what it withheld from outside researchers.

The report compares model confidence with correctness before and after post-training, providing a limited explanation of unreliable confidence. This is evidence of partial understanding, not a test of whether disclosure would enable reliable external failure prediction.
